recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見數個紡錘形、胞質塞滿深紫色異染顆粒的肥大細胞（spindle-shaped mast cells），旁邊聚集許多核偏心、胞質嗜鹼性且有核旁淡染區的漿細胞樣細胞，提示全身性肥大細胞症合併另一種血液腫瘤（SM-AHN）。
features: Spindle-shaped atypical mast cells with elongated nuclei and cytoplasm packed with dark purple metachromatic granules
Mast cells in small aggregates, with granules extending into tapering cytoplasmic tails
Adjacent clusters of plasmacytoid cells with eccentric round nuclei, clumped chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs
Occasional larger cells with abundant blue cytoplasm and immature-appearing chromatin
Admixed eosinophils, lymphocytes and maturing myeloid cells in the background
describe_en: Two fields from a bone marrow aspirate smear. Both show aggregates of spindle-shaped atypical mast cells with elongated nuclei and cytoplasm densely filled with coarse metachromatic granules, a morphology associated with systemic mastocytosis. Closely associated with the mast cells are numerous plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, coarse chromatin, basophilic cytoplasm and perinuclear hofs, along with scattered eosinophils, lymphocytes and myeloid precursors. The nature of the associated neoplasm cannot be determined from morphology alone and requires flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry (CD117, tryptase, CD25, CD138, light chains) and molecular studies. Findings are suggestive of systemic mastocytosis with an associated hematologic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are round to oval, scattered singly and CD25/CD2 negative without KIT D816V, whereas these are spindled mast cells in aggregates.
Basophils have lobulated nuclei and larger, sparser water-soluble granules and are round, not spindled, and lack tryptase/CD117 co-expression typical of mast cells.
Reactive plasma cells are mature, scattered and polytypic, whereas a clonal plasma cell neoplasm shows increased atypical cells with light-chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia and tyrosine kinase fusion
ddx.vs: Neoplasms with PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 fusions can show spindled mast cells with eosinophilia, but lack KIT D816V and carry the fusion by FISH/RT-PCR.
